SIDHARTH PANIGRAHY Senior Business Analyst | Capital Markets | Trade Lifecycle, Corporate Actions, Middle office| SQL & Reconciliation

+91 8431975931 • sid.thehlr@yahoo.com • linkedin.com/in/sidharth-panigrahy

P R O F E S S I O N A L S U M M A R Y

IIBA-certified Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience in trade lifecycle, middle-office operations and reconciliation transformation across Capital Markets and Wealth Management, specializing in AI- driven initiatives and Agile Program Increment (PI) planning. Proven expertise in requirements elicitation, process mapping, and stakeholder engagement across front-office, risk, custody, and IT. Delivered large- scale reconciliation and data migration programs with high accuracy, while driving automation through AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Friday.AI. Adept at bridging business needs with IT solutions, managing resource effort and accelerating delivery.

P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E

Business Process Lead | TCS, Pune Business Analyst, Trade Lifecycle & Middle Office | Capital Markets | GoldenSource | Custody | Enrichment Clients - Goldman Sachs Group, Citi Bank

Apr 2021 – Present

◗ Led end-to-end delivery of 3 middle-office transformation initiatives spanning version upgrades, data

migration, and process automation, coordinating 10-20+ stakeholders across Agile and Waterfall delivery models.

◗ Operated as functional Business Analyst bridging business requirements with IT solutions, re-

engineering transaction workflows across enrichment, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation for Equities, Derivatives, Fixed Income, and FX to lift operational efficiency.

◗ Managed reference data within the GoldenSource EDM platform, supporting security

master, corporate actions, and benchmark/index data accuracy for downstream valuation, risk, and reconciliation processes.

◗ Performed requirements elicitation techniques, gap analysis, and process mapping (As-Is/To- Be) to translate business needs into BRD/FRDs and functional specifications for delivery teams with design solution.

◗ Adopted AI tooling (Friday.AI, Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate epic-to-user-story breakdown and automate documentation; via Jira and Confluence to sustain delivery across workstreams.

◗ Directed data validation and reconciliation in Microsoft SQL Server (SQL queries) during

system migration, achieving 98% data accuracy and minimizing post-migration defect leakage.

◗ Facilitated PI planning sessions and Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, and sprint readiness

with 100% Definition of Ready.

.

◗ Chaired recurring stakeholder forums with front-office, risk, custody, and IT teams (10-20+ participants) to drive requirement sign-off, reducing rework from late-stage changes.

◗ Raised sprint readiness to 100% Definition of Ready by standardizing user story templates and acceptance criteria, reducing in-sprint clarification cycles and supporting UAT planning.

◗ Orchestrated UAT execution and defect management cycles, ensuring 90% of high-priority

bugs were resolved prior to production launch.

Financial Analyst | Eclerx, Pune Trade Confirmation & Documentation | Middle office

Mar 2019 – Mar 2021

◗ Managed trade confirmations and ISDA bilateral documentation across OTC equity, FX, and options

products, ensuring contractual accuracy across high-volume daily trade flows.

◗ Performed gap analysis and SQL-based data checks on documentation discrepancies, resolving

issues with traders, middle office, and legal teams to prevent settlement delays; produced MIS and control reports for management visibility into process health.

◗ Partnered with collateral teams on margining and documentation workflows, supporting timely

◗

collateral calls and reducing documentation-driven settlement friction. Initiated process re-engineering that improved trade confirmation turnaround time and reduced client query volume by an estimated 20-30%, easing pressure on downstream operations teams.

Financial Advisor | Karvy Stock Broking, Hyderabad Financial Advisor, Client Analytics & Portfolio Servicing | Capital Markets

Mar 2017 – Mar 2018

◗ Analyzed customer trading behavior using advanced Excel modeling to surface patterns and trends,

informing targeted sales outreach and client retention strategy.

◗ Partnered with the Sales Team and Portfolio Manager to monitor trade service performance and Supported wealth management journeys and RM functionalities in digital environments.

Jira | Confluence | Microsoft Copilot (AI) | Friday.AI (AI) | Draw.io

E D U C A T I O N & C E R T I F I C A T I O N

Master's in Finance: SSIM, Hyderabad Bachelor's Degree in Accounting & Economics: Khalikote University, Berhampur

SQL Certification from Skill Nation | Advance Data Analytics(TCS) | Six Sigma greenbelt(TCS) |
